    Process a text file of citations via GROBID

    process_citation_file.Rd

    Specialized function for the GROBID "processCitationList" service. Reads a text file containing one raw citation per line, then returns either the raw XML/TEI, or a structured tibble.

    Unlike grobid_process_file() (which accepts, for the "processCitationList" service, either a file path or a vector of raw text citations), process_citation_file() only accepts a single path to an existing .txt file on disk. To directly process a vector of citations without an intermediate file, use grobid_process_file() with service = "processCitationList".

    Usage

    process_citation_file(
  file,
  params = list(),
  output_format = "parsed",
  model_type = .checkrefr_env$grobid_model_type,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    file

    character Path to an existing text file, containing one raw citation per line. Empty lines are ignored.

    params

    list Additional parameters passed to the HTTP form of the GROBID API (e.g. list(consolidateCitations = 1)). See grobid_process_file() for details. Default: list().

    output_format

    character Format of the returned result:

    • "parsed" — structured result (tibble), via parse_citation_list()

    • "raw" — raw XML/TEI string

    Default: "parsed".

    model_type

    character or NA. GROBID model variant to use for extracting bibliographic citations. Two values are possible:

    • "crf" — model based solely on a CRF (Conditional Random Field). Faster, but generally less accurate than the "full" model.

    • "full" — model combining CRF and a neural (deep learning) model. More accurate, but slower and more resource-intensive.

    This parameter corresponds to the model.name / citation configuration of the GROBID YAML configuration file (see the official documentation for details HERE). If NA (default value), in docker mode the model without extension is used, see the GROBID dockerHub documentation for details or use the grobid_docker_list_versions() function. In remote mode a crf model is used by default. Default: .checkrefr_env$grobid_model_type, i.e. NA.

    verbose

    logical If TRUE, displays progress messages in the console (number of citations sent, etc.). Default: TRUE.

    Value

    • output_format = "parsed" → structured tibble with one row per citation (see parse_citation_list() for column details)

    • output_format = "raw" → character containing the raw XML/TEI returned by GROBID

    See also

    grobid_process_file(), parse_citation_list(), grobid_docker_start(), grobid_remote_connect(), checkrefr_set_defaults()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Retrieving a sample citation file provided with the package
txt_file <- system.file("extdata", package = "CheckrefR") |>
  list.files(pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
txt_file <- txt_file[1]

# Processing with structured return (tibble)
citations_df <- process_citation_file(txt_file)

# Processing with raw XML return
citations_xml <- process_citation_file(txt_file, output_format = "raw")
} # }
